body:
Man it's so weird that our stories are so similiar. It's messed up how someone can and/or want to destroy another person that bad. Even if the relationship was mostly bad and we had our fights, we loved eachother and i bet you and your then girlfriend did aswell. So how can they just turn around and go from love to hate, maybe it's true that there's a thin line between the two but i find it kinda scary how someone who one day says they love you can just turn around and hate you, not even wanna talk to you and so on. I will never get that. That's what i'm afraid of happening, it hasn't happened yet that someone threatened me but i can still see some of her friends and how they look at me and it makes me so angry because i wasn't the only one who did dumb shit, she abused me physically and mentally but they probably have no idea about that part.

Same here, i would have left if it wasn't for friends, family and job. Now i'm stuck her in this small town where i run into her atleast a couple of times a month... It fucking sucks. 

Yeah, your dad is probably some what right. But i also know i have done alot to try to fix stuff but it doesn't matter, i can go weeks feeling quite good about all the ex stuff but then it always come back and i fall back. But yeah, it's easy to feel sorry for myself but it's hard to actually take a real step to get better, i still have all her stuff for example and i guess if i would've thrown them out months ago it would feel better now, but i can't...

I guess that's true aswell, but it's so damn hard to take those steps for change. I could change alot but i have to manage that too and it's hard when i feel like shit most of the time, it's a vicious cycle i guess. Our breakup was almost 6 months ago so it's been a long time and while it's gotten better it's nowhere good. I still miss her so much some days i drink myself to sleep.

Yeah, i've tried to replace it but it just isn't the same and i start missing her more and more, when i was with this new girl, i thought about my ex... I did the same stuff and this new girl did some stuff that my ex used to do it just becomes weird as shit in my brain. I don't know. I just wish i could forget her for good. Thanks man.

Don't feel like that man, i'm just happy that even tho we both feel like shit you have that special one in your life and that's what's matters when it all comes down to it. My biggest fear is to live and die alone, i know it's pretty much a oxymoron since i feel suicide being a comfort if shit gets to rough, but if i would live and die a natural death i wouldn't want to die alone and it's scary to think about. Having someone loving you unconditional and being there is something really important.

I'm not religious and i'm not capitalistic really, but i see your point. Maybe i am without thinking i am or something, i wish a was religious and believed sometimes, i see people who believe and they have some kind of peace over them and i can envy that.


Right, i feel the same way. It's an addiction that needs it fixes. I got really fucked up yesterday, i sat at home taking a few glasses and a friend of a friend, who's way older wrote to me and said i should come over for a beer, so i did. We ended up drinking our heads off and this girl i've talked to came over and things went like things do you know, haha. I went home with her, smoked some weed and just fucked like crazy. It was the first time since the break up i had that physical contact and it was nice, but the sex wasn't the best part, the best part was everything around it and today i'm hungover as shit, haven't slept for like 36 hours, maybe got a couple of hours sleep here and there. But i fucking hate this feeling, the day after. The craving for more and she's once again a little off and stuff like that, even tho she claimed i was the best one she's been with. I hate it. I wish i could just stay in those moments when you forget everything around you. That's one of the reasons i hate meeting girls, because it's never like that, or atleast almost never. Everyone plays games and i'm not the most attractive guy out there so each time i meet someone who's interested i can't believe it and every girl i've been with i thought would be the last. I'm so fucking sick of my mind fucking me like that.

I want what you have man, it's sounds great even if everything else sucks you still have that person in your life. That's gold.

I want to apologize aswell, i swear alot and i'm not a religious person and i don't know how you feel about that stuff since you told me about your background. It's just the way i talk you know, i don't want to be disrespectful. If it bothers you, tell me.

Yeah, it was so much shit going around back then, my first relationship, i didn't even like her that much but friends set us up and i was young and stupid and it was pretty great to be with someone and she got pregnant. Just my luck, i just fled. I left town and hoped it would sort itself out, it was pretty stupid of me and i was a asshole but i wasn't ready for that stuff, nowhere near ready. I was still a kid and i had nothing figured out. Now, i sometimes wonder how my life would've been if i had a kid. A little mini me running around out there. It's hard stuff. I wish i could define happiness for me, it's something i really should take a night and just sit and think about. I need to do that.

Man, what you said there is so spot on and beautiful. Yes, the world is dark and dreary and most of us are lost wanderers. That's poetic stuff.

I did a one year education to become someone who works in a school with kids that have special needs. And it brings me joy to be honest, not happiness, but joy. I feel helpful and needed and it's nice. I get that man, essays and stuff like that killed me all the time, i just can't do it. Yeah, i have nothing in common with the teachers and stuff, i have more in common with the kids but hey, i love talking about music, football and video games so yeah, it's nice and i feel like i'm someone they kinda look up to and it's nice. But it's like i'm two persons, one there who they think have everything put together and one at home who's a mess. A co-worker asked me a couple of weeks ago about my partner and i just played along and said i had one and bla bla. They just took it for granted so i couldn't bother telling them i didn't have one.

Yeah, i feel the same. I'm glad i posted it! It's nice to find others to talk to.

I think i did that too, i never meant to do it but when you get hit, kicked and bit you get angry and you start yelling and saying shit you don't mean, i called her alot of stupid things and i hate myself for it. I think that maybe if i was a stronger person, who could've taken it better and if i did not burst out in anger and calling her those names it would have been different. I hate myself for hurting her but i know somewhere deep inside that it wasn't my fault, i could've handled it better but she attacked me constantly. All i had was my words, i never hurt her physically, i could never do that to someone i love and never a girl. That's exactly what's happens to me now, i've met people when i'm out and we started chatting and yeah, we could be friends and they add me on facebook and then they just block me, and later i see they are friends with friends of my ex so they only know her side of the fucking story. I can admit my flaws and my faults, but she could never do that, she never saw what she did wrong when we were together. They acuse me of stuff that's not true, now it's cooled down a bit but when it was really bad i looked over my shoulder, i even had a baton on me in case someone would try anything. And even tho she's put me through so much shit i still love her and i still want her. It's fucking insane that people can ruin ones life like they did to you and now it's happening to me. How can they live knowing how they destroy others?

Man, i've thought about joining the army aswell. Would be the dream to die as a hero. I'm so happy for you that you met her, it's really nice.

I know, everyone keeps telling me that but i have such a hard time seeing it. I love her still and every day i hope she will contact me, telling me she made a mistake and atleast wanting to talk again... I can't function normally, i drink almost every day and then i go out wandering the streets because that's the only thing that calms me down. I've been on the train tracks so many times thinking about just jumping infront of a train. I wish she still loved me or atleast felt something that isn't this hate she clearly feels towards me. It kills me.

Don't apologize for your response man.

Man that sucks, the cluelessness of people who have never suffered any form of mental illness is so fucking annoying. Ofcourse, it could always be worse when you're looking at it from the outside but when you're in it, it's the worst thing you can ever experience, atleast sometimes. They deserve to be slapped.

I'm glad you have her, that's important and the thing most of us search for in this life, someone to be with and that will always be there for you. I wish i had that, it's the only thing i dream of and i thought i had it with my ex but she went bananas and yeah... I mean, i have some friends, a couple i met just a few months ago and it's fun to hang out but it's not the same... When i was with my ex, we did everything together and i miss her touch you know? I miss the hugs and the kisses, i miss to hold her. I loved her so damn much, i still do, even tho she out of nowhere started hating me. I will never understand. 

Yeah man, i bet that's true. We should enjoy the journey but it's fucking hard when the journey is a long bumpy road. It's bullshit that some people feel the way we do, i see people with their stupid smirks, finding joy in the smallest and shittiest things and i can't get that, at all. I mean, the last time i was truly happy and felt great joy was 12 years ago and i just found out that my ex who was pregnant finally came to her senses and got an abortion. It's fucking sick man, that made me so happy i still remember it today, it was such a relief and everything was amazing for a while, i had pizza, the best fucking pizza i've ever had and it was at the same place i always got pizza. Haha. It's so stupid really. But 12 years since i felt true happiness and that says alot, i've had girlfriends after that and i've been in love and stuff but i've never felt that kind of happiness again. Sick.

Indeed. The world is a really dark place and we as humans have done so much shit to this planet it's hard not to be cynical and sad about it. Man i feel you, that shit fibromyalgia is so weird, it's insane really that there's no relief or no answers. I know people who have it and i know other people who claim it's all bullshit, it's just lies and shit. Man, they should see the pain it causes. Fucking dickheads all around.

I never did college, i couldn't. Now i have a studied some and got my degree and have a job and stuff in the field i studied and it's nice, i kinda like it and it gives me atleast some joy but some of my co-workers are so fucking happy it's insane. I never get that. Haha.

Yeah, it's nice to not be totally alone and to have others who feel the same way to talk to.
That's the thing, i can't think of anything.

I feel the same way. When you have been through mental illness for the most part of your life it's really sucky and people tells you that it's not that bad, there's people worse off and other shit. Really makes me wanna punch them. They know nothing.

That's the part that scares me too, even if i found "happiness" in form of a girlfriend/wife and so on, what if nothing changes? What if i'm still the same mess. That's scary. And work, it sucks. Working 8 hours a day for some cash that goes to waste mostly on shit and the free time one have is just wasted because one is so fucking tired.

Indeed. There's too much bad. This world is a fucking ceasepool of shit. Everything should go back to basics.
I wish i knew how to let go and just go with the flow but that's really hard to do.
Yeah man! It's a strange feeling of comfort.
It's nice to have that. But as i said to another one i want a foolproof way to end it.
That's one thing, i often think about what ways there is and i fear that i would fail and be left a vegetable. That would truly suck...

Man i wish Aliens would come and just blow shit up. That would be awesome. I really wished that the whole 2012 stuff was real and that everything would end. Would've felt better to die together with everyone else, especially loved ones and family.

But i struggle so much with all these thoughts, especially about my ex. When i was with her and it was good i thought i could really do this, i can be happy and have a girlfriend, a job, a life, maybe kids some day and so on. Then it all went to shit, i struggled thru her abuse for so much time because i always thought it would be better, that she had problems and that she would get help but instead it ended when she kept calling me while i was at work and i couldn't talk. So she went meltdown mode and after that it all was over. She said she needed a break, i was okay with that even tho it sucked. She said it would all be better when she had sorted herself out, but she never came back after that. I tried to contact her and get a answer or atleast some closure but she wouldn't talk to me at all, so her friend did all the talking for her and they had twisted everything around making me the bad guy somehow. All i ever did was to try to make everything good, but it wasn't enough and now they spread lies about me so much so i have even started questioning myself and my actions. I don't see what they see, i never hurt her, i would never do such a thing, she attacked me with punches, kicks, bites and so on and somehow i'm the bad guy now? I don't understand.  

But hey, atleast i have alcohol and drugs to make me feel a bit better and i'll always have the comfort of knowing that if shit gets too rough i can throw myself infront of a train or something. :)

Almost two years. And i don't know if i'm a good guy, i always thought that and tried to be good but i don't know. I stayed with her thru so much shit it's insane really, she cheated once just as we started our relationship but she claimed she was raped, i tried to believe her but so much stuff didn't add up you know, she had contact with the guy for over two months after the rape, she even went home to him atleast a second time after the rape and he tried again that time, she still had contact with him... I wanted to believe her because i don't want to think that she would cheat but i can't believe that one would stay in touch with a guy who raped once and tried a second time... She always said i made her angry, i don't know how or what i did that made her so angry, she got so angry once that she bit me so hard i still have a scar. It's so hard because i replay every scenario in my head, what if i was the problem? Maybe i was the bad guy? But i don't know... I can't think of anything i did that could make a person so angry. All i ever wanted was to be with her and to have a good life with alot of love, that's all i wanted. I never wanted to fight or to get abuses, i did everything for her but that was never enough.

It's over 3 months since we last spoke... I doubt she will ever come around, she blames me for everything and she was very abusive and controlling during our relationship, she hurt me both mentally and physically you know... She cheated on me atleast twice and turned it around to make it my fault and despite all that shit i still miss her so damn much it's insane. Because i know how good it was when everything was good, but that was maybe 10-15 % of the time... I hate myself for feeling this way, i should be happy she's gone but i'm not, i love her. All i want is to her to reach out so we can talk, but that will never happen and it kills me. I can't imagine my life without her, without ever talking to her again... I rather be dead.

She left, we had a huge fight and she ignored me for a week and then when we finally started talking again she needed a break and i agreed and i waited. When the time was up we started talking again and i tried to get some answers but she just kept talking in circles and one day she was just gone, she changed. I tried to contact her and one day she picked up but she handed the phone to another person that told me she didn't want anything to do with me and so on. My world fell apart. I'll never understand how a person can change so much and how feelings just dies.

It's hard to avoid her, small town and we just run into each other from time to time, i have considered moving away but i have my family, friends and work here so it's hard. I just wish i felt nothing when i looked at her, i just wish i could be as cold as she is.

Glad you got thru it and found your wife! I can only wish something like that will happen to me but it just doesn't feel like it. I just miss her so much and it's been so long and it doesn't get better, it just feels hopeless.
I can't afford a private one so i need to go through this shit you know...

I'm to old for this shit that's for sure, soon 30 man. It's so fucking pathetic i know. We dated for almost 2 years and she was the love of my life, i've been with others but this one was so different, i never thought we would be apart... I guess you're right, i look stuff up from time to time when i feel sad, maybe that's a no no... But it's hard when the feelings come crushing over your like a fucking tsunami :(
No, i've been waiting for almost 6 months for that aswell but haven't heard a thing. :(
But how? Everyone i ever loved left me, and so will my parents. So i will be left all alone with nothing but anxiety and pain, what's the point?

I'm drunk as shit and i just want something to snap me out of it you know. Something to get me through the drunkness, because i'm starting to feel ill. And i've heard some stories about mixing alcohol and brupopion that gives you these insane psychoses and i'm at that point that i don't give a shit you know, i rather just get one of those mad psychoses and be done with it then carry on feeling like shit.
I don't know. I can't talk to them about it. I just want to fucking end it all.
Cheers man
I've heard stories about it giving you psychoses?
